name: manual_2c84b1
claim: When a merged helper is tested only against a fake store, add at least one test against the real store engine and one with terminal history present; fakes that hide history or constraints let code diverge from its spec while staying green.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: the merged permit helper had fake-store tests, no production caller, and minted a second permit when terminal rows were hidden; the reviewer reproduced it in memory.

rationale: 2026-10-19: the merged permit helper had fake-store tests, no production caller, and minted a second permit when terminal rows were hidden; the reviewer reproduced it in memory.
